messages:
anya: hi team — tried to pick up my prescription today and the pharmacy refused because my last name on my DL != last name on the insurance portal (i changed my name after marriage). they said they need the name on the ID to match the insurance card. any quick options?

mike-hr: ugh, congrats on the marriage but annoying timing. did you get a new insurance card yet? sometimes digital cards update faster.

anya: i haven't received a physical card yet. the insurer portal still shows my old last name. i updated through benefits a week ago (submitted name change docs).

zoe-benefits: thanks for flagging @anya. process note: we submit name-change requests to the carrier and they typically update the member file in 3-10 business days. if you already uploaded marriage certificate and SSN update, you're in the queue.

pharm-bot: pharmacy options: 1) pharmacist can do a manual ID override if the member signs a statement and the prescriber confirms Rx; 2) use secondary ID (passport) + patient-signed attestation; 3) pharmacy can fill as cash and you file for reimbursement.

anya: pharmacist said they could do an override but need a signed attestation and a phone call from benefits or my prescriber to confirm identity. can benefits call the pharmacy?

zoe-benefits: we can call. give me the pharmacy phone and the prescription number. also paste the confirmation email you got when you submitted name-change to benefits so we can cite the request.

anya: pharmacy: 206-555-0199, Rx#: 0456789. confirmation email subject: "Name change request received" (i'll forward).

claims-bot: docs that speed pickup/appeal: scanned marriage certificate, driver license, screenshot of insurer portal showing pending update, pharmacy attestation form (signed), prescriber verification note. If pharmacy fills and you pay cash, keep receipt and paid invoice to submit for reimbursement. Typical reimbursement processing: 10-30 days after claim submission.

zoe-benefits: sample attestation text for you to sign at the pharmacy: 
"I, Anya R., confirm that I am the same person listed on the prescription Rx#0456789 and that my identity has recently changed from Anya S. to Anya R. I authorize the pharmacist to fill this prescription despite the name difference."

mike-hr: if the pharmacy refuses to accept an attestation, we can ask the insurer for a temporary member ID letter (called a 'member verification letter') that the pharmacy accepts. i'll call our carrier rep and request a one-off verification.

anya: thank you — i can sign the attestation now. please call the pharmacy so they accept it.

zoe-benefits: calling pharmacy now to confirm they will accept the attestation + prescriber callback. i'll also request expedited member verification from the carrier.

pharm-bot: reminder: if filled as cash, submit reimbursement to claims@healthcarrier.example with subject "Pharmacy Reimbursement: Anya R. Rx 0456789" and include receipt, prescriber Rx, and explanation.

anya: forwarding confirmation email and attaching marriage cert to benefits@redwood.com (subject: NAME CHANGE - Anya R.). thanks all! :heart:

zoe-benefits: got it. i'll post update when carrier sends verification or when pharmacy confirms pickup. use this thread for any follow-ups.
